name: Ahrefs
summary: An SEO toolkit for backlinks, keyword research and site audits, used by professionals.
strengths: a large link and keyword database
watchOutFor: A paid product, with some free tools for your own site.
More than a casual site owner needs.

name: Airtable
summary: A spreadsheet-style database for tracking projects, content and records, with views and automations.
watchOutFor: Free use limits records and features. Check the current rules.
Can be pricey for larger teams.

name: Apple Notes
summary: The notes app built into iPhone, iPad and Mac, which syncs through iCloud.
strengths: built in and free on Apple devices
watchOutFor: Works best only inside the Apple ecosystem.
Few options for exporting.

name: Asana
summary: A work management tool for teams, with projects, timelines and task dependencies.
strengths: lists, boards and timelines for one project
watchOutFor: More than one person usually needs.
Free use limits some features. Check the current rules.

name: Beautiful.ai
summary: A presentation tool that arranges slide content automatically, with templates and AI help.
strengths: slides that keep their layout as you add content
watchOutFor: Mostly paid. Check the trial on the official page.
Less freedom to move things around.

name: Bhashini
summary: India's government language platform for translation and speech tools across Indian languages.
strengths: a public initiative with open tools
watchOutFor: Features differ between the website, apps and APIs. Check the official page.
Check important translations.

name: Bing Webmaster Tools
summary: Microsoft's free tool for seeing and improving how your site appears in Bing.
strengths: can import your sites from Search Console
watchOutFor: Bing is a smaller share of search in many countries.
You need to verify that you own the site.

name: DeepL
summary: A translation service known for natural-sounding results, with a writing assistant and document translation.
watchOutFor: Check Indian-language support on the official page.
Free use limits text length. Check the current rules.

name: Enhancv
summary: An online resume builder with designed templates and writing suggestions.
strengths: prompts that suggest what to write
watchOutFor: Downloads may need a paid plan.
Heavy design can be hard for applicant systems to read.

name: Fathom
summary: An AI meeting recorder that transcribes and summarises video calls and highlights key moments.
strengths: summaries soon after a call ends
watchOutFor: Check what the free plan allows.
Tell people when you record a meeting.

name: Fireflies.ai
summary: A meeting assistant that records, transcribes and summarises calls, and makes them searchable.
watchOutFor: Free use is limited. Check the current rules.
Tell people when you record a meeting.

name: FlowCV
summary: A simple online resume builder with clean templates and PDF export.
watchOutFor: Check what the free plan includes.
Keep the layout simple so tracking systems can read it.

name: Gamma
summary: An AI presentation tool that builds a slide deck, document or page from a short prompt.
strengths: a full draft deck from a short prompt
quick restyling of the whole deck
watchOutFor: Generated slides still need your facts checked and your own words.
Exporting may be limited on free plans.

name: Gmail
summary: Google's email service, with Gemini features that help draft and summarise on some accounts.
strengths: a familiar inbox with strong search
AI drafting help on supported accounts
watchOutFor: AI features depend on your account and plan.
Check what an AI feature reads from your mail.

name: Google Docs
summary: Google's online word processor, with sharing, comments and optional Gemini writing help.
watchOutFor: AI features depend on your account type and plan.
Layout can change when exporting to Word.

name: Google Keep
summary: Google's simple app for quick notes, checklists and reminders.
strengths: very quick for short notes and lists
watchOutFor: Not built for long or structured notes.
Check the storage rules for your Google account.

name: Google Search Console
summary: Google's free tool that shows how your site appears in Google Search and what to fix.
strengths: shows search queries and indexing problems
watchOutFor: You need to verify that you own the site.
Data is delayed by a few days.

name: Google Sheets
summary: Google's online spreadsheet, with real-time sharing and Gemini help on some accounts.
watchOutFor: AI features depend on your account and plan.
Check AI-written formulas on a few rows.

name: Google Slides
summary: A browser-based slide editor in Google's office suite, with real-time sharing.
strengths: free sharing and joint editing with a Google account
watchOutFor: It has fewer design extras than dedicated tools.
Complex animation is limited.

name: Google Translate
summary: Google's free translator for text, speech, images and web pages, covering many Indian languages.
watchOutFor: Check important translations, especially legal or medical.
Idioms and context can be wrong.

name: Grammarly
summary: A writing assistant that checks grammar, spelling, clarity and tone as you type.
strengths: fixing grammar and tone as you type
a browser extension for email and documents
watchOutFor: It suggests. You decide. Do not accept every change.
Your text is sent to its servers. Read its privacy terms.

name: Hemingway Editor
summary: A simple editor that highlights long sentences and hard-to-read passages to make writing clearer.
watchOutFor: It judges readability, not facts or tone.
Some features are in a paid version.

name: IFTTT
summary: A simple service for connecting apps and smart devices with if-this-then-that rules.
watchOutFor: Simpler than other tools, so less flexible.
Free use limits applets. Check the current rules.

name: Jobscan
summary: A tool that compares your resume with a job post and shows missing keywords and formatting issues.
strengths: compares a resume against a job post
watchOutFor: Free use is limited. Check the current rules.
Do not copy keywords you cannot back up.

name: Keynote
summary: Apple's presentation app for Mac, iPhone and iPad, with polished templates and animations.
watchOutFor: Apple devices only for editing, with web access via iCloud.
Exporting to PowerPoint can change the layout.

name: Kickresume
summary: An online resume and cover letter builder with templates and AI writing help.
strengths: resume and cover letter in one place
watchOutFor: Many features are paid. Check the current rules.
Review AI-written text for accuracy.

name: LanguageTool
summary: A grammar and style checker with an open-source core that supports many languages.
strengths: an open-source core you can run yourself
watchOutFor: Its free version has limits.
It catches errors but does not improve your argument.

name: LibreOffice
summary: A free, open-source office suite with a word processor, spreadsheet and presentation program.
strengths: opens and saves common Office files
watchOutFor: No built-in AI assistant.
Complex Office files may look different.

name: Logseq
summary: A free, open-source note-taking app built around linked notes and daily journals, stored as local files.
strengths: notes stay on your computer as plain files
watchOutFor: The outline style takes getting used to.
Syncing between devices needs set-up.

name: Make
summary: A visual automation builder for connecting apps with branching flows and data handling.
strengths: a visual canvas for detailed flows
fine control over data between steps
watchOutFor: More to learn than simpler tools.
Free use limits operations. Check the current rules.

name: Microsoft Excel
summary: Microsoft's spreadsheet app, with Copilot help for formulas and analysis on some plans.
strengths: the standard for spreadsheets at work
watchOutFor: Copilot features depend on the plan.
Check AI-written formulas on a few rows.

name: Microsoft OneNote
summary: Microsoft's note-taking app with notebooks, sections and pages, and support for handwriting.
strengths: a free-form page layout and handwriting
syncs across devices with a Microsoft account
watchOutFor: Search and sync depend on your Microsoft account setup.
Structure is notebook-based, not linked notes.

name: Microsoft PowerPoint
summary: Microsoft's slide presentation program, available on desktop, mobile and the web.
watchOutFor: Some features need a paid Microsoft 365 plan.
Files may look different on another computer if fonts are missing.

name: Microsoft Translator
summary: Microsoft's translator for text, speech and conversations, in apps and Microsoft products.
watchOutFor: Check important translations.
Language coverage differs between features.

name: Microsoft Word
summary: Microsoft's word processor for documents, with Copilot writing help on some plans.
watchOutFor: Copilot features depend on the plan. Check the official page.
Full desktop use needs a Microsoft 365 plan.

name: n8n
summary: A workflow automation tool you can self-host or use hosted, with a visual editor and AI nodes.
strengths: self-host it or use the cloud version
visual editor with code when needed
watchOutFor: Self-hosting means you secure and update it.
Check its licence terms for commercial use.

name: Notion
summary: A workspace for notes, tables, task lists and planning pages, with optional AI features.
strengths: notes, tables and plans in one place
watchOutFor: It can get complicated. Start with one page.
AI features may need a paid plan.

name: Obsidian
summary: A note-taking app that stores notes as plain files on your device and links them together.
strengths: notes kept as plain files on your own device
links between notes that build a map of ideas
watchOutFor: Syncing across devices may cost extra.
It takes time to set up a system that suits you.

name: Otter.ai
summary: A meeting assistant that records, transcribes and summarises calls, with notes you can search.
watchOutFor: Free use limits minutes. Check the current rules.
Tell people when you record a meeting.

name: Microsoft Outlook
summary: Microsoft's email and calendar app, with Copilot features on some plans.
strengths: email, calendar and tasks in one app
Copilot drafting help on supported plans
watchOutFor: Copilot features depend on the plan.
Check what an AI feature reads from your mail.

name: Overleaf
summary: An online LaTeX editor for papers, theses and resumes with ready templates.
strengths: many templates for papers and CVs
watchOutFor: You need to learn LaTeX basics.
Some features, such as longer history, are paid.

name: Pitch
summary: A collaborative presentation app with modern templates, aimed at teams and start-ups.
watchOutFor: Check what the free plan limits.
Aimed at teams more than a single student.

name: Microsoft Power Automate
summary: Microsoft's tool for automating work across Microsoft 365 and other services, including desktop actions.
watchOutFor: Premium connectors are paid.
Mostly aimed at Microsoft account users.

name: QuillBot
summary: A writing helper that paraphrases text, checks grammar and summarises passages.
watchOutFor: Do not paraphrase to hide copying. Cite your sources.
Many features need a paid plan.

name: Reactive Resume
summary: A free, open-source resume builder that works in the browser and exports to PDF.
watchOutFor: Check that the exported file opens and copies cleanly.
Keep your own copy of the content.

name: Reverso
summary: A translator with example sentences from real texts, plus grammar checking and a dictionary.
watchOutFor: Check important translations.
Some features need a paid plan.

name: Screaming Frog SEO Spider
summary: A desktop crawler that scans a website like a search engine to find broken links and SEO issues.
strengths: finds broken links and missing tags
a free version for small sites
watchOutFor: Technical output. It takes time to read.
The free version limits the pages it crawls.

name: Scrivener
summary: A writing app for long projects such as books and theses, with a binder to organise chapters and notes.
strengths: research and notes kept next to the draft
watchOutFor: A paid app with a trial listed on the official page.
More features than a short document needs.

name: Semrush
summary: An all-in-one marketing toolkit for SEO, ads and content research.
strengths: keyword, competitor and audit tools in one place
watchOutFor: A paid product with limited free use.
A lot of features. Learn one area at a time.

name: Superhuman
summary: A fast email client built around keyboard shortcuts, with AI drafting and sorting.
strengths: AI drafting in your own style
watchOutFor: A paid product. Check the trial on the official page.
Works on top of Gmail and Outlook accounts.

name: Teal
summary: A job-search tool that combines a resume builder with an application tracker and a browser extension.
strengths: tailor a resume to a job post
watchOutFor: Some features are paid. Check the current rules.
Review AI-written text for accuracy.

name: Todoist
summary: A to-do list and task manager with projects, due dates and recurring tasks.
strengths: quick to add tasks in plain language
watchOutFor: Free use limits projects and features. Check the current rules.
Simple compared with full project tools.

name: Trello
summary: A card-and-board tool for organising tasks as columns, popular for simple team and personal projects.
watchOutFor: Free use limits some features. Check the current rules.
Boards get messy without a routine.

name: Ubersuggest
summary: A simpler SEO tool for keyword ideas, site audits and competitor checks.
watchOutFor: Free use is limited. Check the current rules.
Data depth is lower than the largest suites.

name: Whisper
summary: OpenAI's open-source speech-to-text model that turns audio into text in many languages, on your own computer.
strengths: runs offline, so recordings stay on your computer
watchOutFor: It needs some technical set-up, or an app that wraps it.
Check names and numbers in the transcript.

name: Yoast SEO
summary: A WordPress plug-in that helps you set titles, descriptions and readability for each page.
strengths: guidance as you edit a WordPress page
technical SEO settings handled for you
watchOutFor: WordPress only.
Some features are paid. Check the official page.

name: Zapier
summary: A service that connects thousands of apps so an event in one starts an action in another, without code.
strengths: connects a very large number of apps
no code needed for most workflows
watchOutFor: Free use limits tasks. Check the current rules.
Costs rise as workflows grow.

name: Zoom AI Companion
summary: Zoom's built-in AI assistant that summarises meetings and drafts follow-ups for supported accounts.
strengths: built into Zoom, no extra tool
watchOutFor: Availability depends on your Zoom plan.
Tell people when you record or summarise a meeting.
